summary: The implementation conforms to the saved Issue #412 plan. HEAD adds the preferred one-time Alembic data migration 0f1e2d3c4b5a after f9a0b1c2d3e4, with a no-op append-only downgrade, deterministic pending marker IDs, workspace-local event_order reservation, and idempotent current-cycle marker checks. It backfills only the latest effective terminal_runtime_released rows whose payload explicitly records auth_overlay_unmounted false, skips non-qualifying true/null/missing payloads, superseded release-revoked rows, and rows with existing current-cycle pending/resolved/exhausted markers, and writes workspace.terminal_auth_overlay_unmount_pending with TERMINAL_AUTH_OVERLAY_UNMOUNT_PENDING plus the expected compose_project_name/workspace_status/attempt=1 payload. The runtime retry scan remains unchanged and event-type based; JSON interpretation is isolated to the migration helper and covered on PostgreSQL plus a SQLite minimal-schema path. Focused tests cover the pre-upgrade failed-release backfill flowing into the existing retry sweep and resolving, existing-marker no-op, idempotence with event_sequence advancing only once, non-qualifying filters, SQLite parsing without JSON predicates, and the Alembic single-head update. The recorded validation summary shows the focused pytest, ruff, and mypy checks passing; full AWF/GitHub validation and the hard 99% coverage gate remain owned by the post-agent validation phase per the workspace contract.
